title: pert.li project exchange
description: Portable, layout-free JSON format for sharing PERT projects between instances of pert.li. Tasks carry their predecessors inline via `dependsOn`; container interfaces are co-located on the container task that owns them. Layout state, derived analytics (ES/EF, Monte Carlo), and per-user view state are intentionally not exchanged. Keep this file in sync with src/lib/pert/exchange.ts.

format.description: Discriminator — distinguishes a pert.li exchange file from other JSON documents.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when a backwards-incompatible change is made to this schema.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the file was produced.

DependencyType.description: PERT-style edge relationship between predecessor and successor. Defaults to finish_to_start when omitted.

Estimate.description: Three-point PERT estimate. By convention: optimistic <= mostLikely <= pessimistic.

taskId.description: Predecessor task id. Mutually exclusive with interfaceId.

interfaceId.description: Predecessor container interface id. Mutually exclusive with taskId.

DependsOnEntry.description: A single predecessor relationship. The owning task is the successor. Storage-internal dependency ids and lag/lead days are not part of the exchange contract — importers synthesize fresh ids, and lag (which has no GUI control) does not round-trip.

taskRef.description: Descendant task id this interface routes to / from.

InterfaceEntry.description: A container's entry or exit port. Only meaningful when the owning task has kind === "container".

parentId.description: Parent container's id, or null when the task lives at the project root.

key.description: Dotted-segment grouping label (e.g. "M1.A"). Purely for grouping in views — not a dependency.

actualStart.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd date the task actually started.

actualFinish.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd date the task actually finished.

dependsOn.description: Predecessors of this task. Empty / omitted means the task starts as soon as its parent allows.

interfaces.description: Container ports — only meaningful when kind === "container".

startDate.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Day 0 of the project schedule.

workingDays.description: ISO weekdays counted as working days. 1=Mon … 7=Sun.

holidays.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd dates treated as non-working regardless of weekday.
